propositions: structured_run.py exceeds 500-LOC target (796 LOC) and approaches 800 LOC hard cap, blocking further additions without module-size gate failure

three distinct responsibilities (run mechanism, cache-effectiveness diagnostics, failure interpretation) are conflated in a single module, violating separation of concerns and making future changes harder

cache-diagnostics cluster (~230 LOC: warn_if_cache_ineffective, cache_write_never_read, warn_if_cache_write_never_read, estimate_marked_prefix_tokens, _warn_if_zeroed_usage) must be extracted to a new module to reduce structured_run.py below 500 LOC

failure-interpretation cluster (~180 LOC: FailureContext, interpret_failure, _write_parse_failure_artifact) must be extracted to a new module to eliminate back-edge dependencies and prevent future re-inflation

public import paths from external callers (runner.py, usage_report.py, capabilities.py) and existing tests must remain stable via re-exports from structured_run.py to avoid test edits and caller changes
after split, structured_run.py retains only the run mechanism (~390 LOC), creating a stable, one-way dependency hierarchy with cache_diagnostics.py and run_failure.py as pure observability modules
